releaseNotes:
Official Release v1.3.145:
- NATIVE 32-BIT DPFPApi.dll ARCHITECTURE FIX: Replaced 64-bit DPFPApi.dll with matching 32-bit manufacturer binary, completely eliminating the 0x8007000B (incorrect format) error and ensuring hardware reader initialization and indicator lights turn on reliably on all Windows 10/11 stations.
- OFFICIAL DIGITALPERSONA BIOMETRIC ENGINE: Integrated official DPFP.Verification and DPFP.Processing.Enrollment engines with true minutiae-based biometric matching across all stations, replacing legacy static string hashes with real mathematical ridge pattern verification.
- DYNAMIC BIOMETRIC TEMPLATE SYNCHRONIZATION: Automatic background synchronization of enrolled employee templates from central server to local hardware bridge via WebSocket.
